headline.caveat: reported as 'more than $10B' over six years; exact value undisclosed

nature_md: Six-year agreement (reported Aug 2025) under which Meta spends more than $10B on Google Cloud servers, storage, networking, and related services, mainly for AI infrastructure — a rare case of one hyperscaler renting a direct rival's cloud because internal capacity could not keep pace with AI demand. Meta also holds cloud arrangements with AWS and Azure.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Cloud services expensed as consumed (opex/cost of revenue); a purchase commitment in footnotes, not capex.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Google Cloud revenue for Alphabet, recognized as delivered — part of the Cloud segment's AI-driven acceleration (+82% y/y in 2026). A competitor becoming a >$10B customer is itself evidence of industry-wide capacity shortage.
